description: Building web pages that work on every device and every connection: semantic HTML, modern CSS layout, responsive design, media and the JavaScript that brings pages to life. Taught to the depth of a leading front-end web development course.
modelledOn: Duckett, HTML and CSS: Design and Build Websites
Duckett, JavaScript and jQuery: Interactive Front-End Web Development
outcomes: Write valid, semantic, accessible HTML documents with correct structure, lists, tables, links, images and forms.
Style pages with CSS selectors, the box model, flexbox and grid, and organise stylesheets maintainably.
Build layouts that adapt to phones, tablets and desktops and remain fast on slow connections.
Embed and control audio, video and canvas content.
Write JavaScript that manipulates the DOM, handles events and validates forms.
Debug and test pages with browser developer tools and publish them to a web host.

units.title: How the Web works and HTML building blocks
topics: Clients, servers, HTTP requests and responses, URLs, browsers and rendering
HTML document structure: doctype, head, body, metadata, character encoding
Elements, attributes, nesting; headings, paragraphs, emphasis, line breaks, comments
Document sections: header, nav, main, article, section, aside, footer; why semantics matter
Validation and developer tools; writing a first multi-page site

units.title: Lists and tables
topics: Ordered, unordered and description lists; nested lists for menus
Tables: rows, cells, headers, caption, thead/tbody/tfoot, rowspan and colspan
Accessible tables with scope and headers; when not to use a table
Tabular data from a Ghanaian school timetable or a market price list

units.title: Links and images
topics: Anchors, absolute and relative URLs, fragments, mailto and tel links; link states
Images: formats (JPEG, PNG, GIF, SVG, WebP), alt text, dimensions, figure and figcaption
Responsive images with srcset and picture; image optimisation for low bandwidth
Icons, favicons and image maps

units.title: Forms
topics: form, input types (text, email, number, date, password, checkbox, radio, file), select, textarea, button
Labels, fieldsets, placeholders and accessibility
HTML5 validation attributes: required, pattern, min, max
GET versus POST and what happens when a form is submitted

units.title: Cascading Style Sheets
topics: Inline, internal and external CSS; selectors (type, class, id, attribute, pseudo-class, pseudo-element); specificity and the cascade
Colour, typography, web fonts, units (px, em, rem, %, vw)
The box model: margin, border, padding, content; box-sizing; display and visibility
Positioning: static, relative, absolute, fixed, sticky; z-index; floats
Flexbox and CSS grid for page layout; alignment and spacing
Transitions, transforms and simple animations; CSS variables; organising stylesheets

units.title: Responsive HTML
topics: Viewport meta tag; fluid layouts; mobile-first design
Media queries for width, orientation and dark mode
Responsive navigation, images and tables
Performance on 2G/3G: minimising requests, compression, lazy loading; testing with throttling
Accessibility basics: contrast, keyboard navigation, ARIA landmarks

units.title: HTML media
topics: audio and video elements, sources, formats, controls, captions with track
Embedding maps, YouTube and other iframes safely
SVG inline graphics and the canvas element
Considerations for data cost and autoplay

units.title: JavaScript basics
topics: Adding scripts; variables (let, const), types, operators, strings, arrays, objects
Functions, arrow functions, conditionals and loops; the console and debugging
The DOM: selecting elements, changing content and styles, creating and removing nodes
Events: click, input, submit, keyboard; event listeners and the event object
Form validation and dynamic forms; local storage
Fetching JSON from an API and rendering it; introduction to promises
Project: a responsive multi-page site with an interactive feature, published to a static host

schedule.title: How the Web works and first HTML
schedule.exercise: Short exercise: describe the steps from typing a URL to seeing a page, then write a one-page profile of yourself with headings, paragraphs and emphasis.

tasks.title: Request a page in the browser tools, read the HTTP request and response headers and note the status code, content type and size
Write a valid HTML page with doctype, head, title, charset and body, and check it displays correctly in the preview
Fix an HTML page with five nesting and attribute errors, and add headings, paragraphs and comments so the outline is correct

schedule.title: Semantic sections and a first site
schedule.exercise: Plan the pages of a small business site on paper and say which semantic element each region uses.

tasks.title: Rewrite a page made only of div elements using header, nav, main, article, aside and footer, and check the outline
Validate a page with an HTML validator, fix every reported error and inspect its structure with developer tools
Build a three-page site for a Kumasi tailoring shop with a shared navigation, consistent structure and no validation errors

schedule.title: Lists and tables
schedule.exercise: Mark up your weekly timetable as an accessible table and a navigation menu as a nested list.

tasks.title: Write an ordered list of recipe steps, an unordered shopping list and a description list of three terms with definitions
Build a market price table with a caption, header and footer rows and a colspan total row, and display it correctly
Mark up a school timetable with rowspan for double lessons and scope attributes so a screen reader announces each cell correctly

schedule.title: Links and images
schedule.exercise: Choose an image format and size for five images on a news page and write alt text for each.

tasks.title: Link between three pages with relative URLs, add a fragment link to a section, and a mailto and tel link
Insert a figure with caption and write alt text for a photograph, a decorative icon and an informative chart
Serve responsive images with srcset and picture, compress them and reduce a page from 3 MB to under 500 KB while keeping them sharp

schedule.title: Forms
schedule.exercise: Design a registration form for a youth club on paper, listing each field's input type and validation rule.

tasks.title: Build a contact form with text, email, select, checkbox and radio inputs and a submit button, then submit it and read the data
Add required, pattern, min and max validation to a sign-up form for a Ghanaian phone number, age and email, and test good and bad inputs
Compare GET and POST by submitting the same form both ways, inspecting the request, and explain which suits a login form and a search box

schedule.title: CSS basics
schedule.exercise: Style a plain page with a stylesheet and explain which selector won in three conflicting rules.

tasks.title: Link an external stylesheet and style headings, links and a class using type, class and id selectors
Fix a stylesheet where three rules conflict by working out specificity, and use a pseudo-class for hover and a pseudo-element for a quotation mark
Set a colour palette and a web font with rem units and check text contrast, then change the base font size and watch everything scale

schedule.title: Box model and positioning
schedule.exercise: Draw the box model of a card with margin, border and padding values measured in pixels, then reproduce it in CSS.

tasks.title: Style a card with margin, border and padding and use box-sizing so that its total width is exactly 300 pixels
Build a header that stays sticky with a fixed floating button, using positioning and z-index so nothing is hidden
Debug a layout where elements overlap and overflow, using developer tools to find the margin collapse and display issues, and fix each

schedule.title: Flexbox, grid and animation
schedule.exercise: Sketch a page layout and decide which parts use flexbox and which use grid, with reasons.

tasks.title: Arrange a navigation bar with flexbox, space the items evenly and centre a hero heading both horizontally and vertically
Build a three-column product grid with CSS grid that collapses to one column on a narrow screen, with consistent gaps
Add a hover transition, a keyframe animation and CSS variables for a theme, and organise the stylesheet into labelled sections

schedule.title: Responsive design
schedule.exercise: Test a page at 320, 768 and 1200 pixels and list five problems with the original and the fix applied.

tasks.title: Add the viewport meta tag and make a fixed-width page fluid using percentages and max-width, then test on a narrow screen
Write media queries for narrow screens, landscape orientation and dark mode, and test each with the browser's emulation
Reduce a page's size and requests for a throttled 3G connection using compression and lazy loading, and report the load time before and after

schedule.title: Media and embedded content
schedule.exercise: Plan the media for a school website with a data cost budget and write a note about autoplay.

tasks.title: Embed an audio and a video element with controls, two source formats and a captions track, and check they play
Embed a map and a video in iframes with sandbox and lazy loading, and explain what each attribute protects against
Draw an inline SVG logo and an animated canvas chart of monthly rainfall, and compare how each scales on a high-resolution screen

schedule.title: JavaScript and the DOM
schedule.exercise: Problem set: trace ten small JavaScript snippets by hand and then check each result in the console.

tasks.title: Declare variables, an array and an object in JavaScript, loop over them, and print the results to the console
Write functions with conditionals and loops to compute a grade average and debug a failing one using the console and breakpoints
Select elements by id and class, create and remove list items and change styles in response to a button, using only DOM methods

schedule.title: Events, forms and storage
schedule.exercise: Describe the event flow for a button click, including bubbling, and design the data stored for a to-do list.

tasks.title: Add click, input and keyboard event listeners to show a live character count and respond to the Enter key
Validate a sign-up form in JavaScript with inline error messages and save the draft in local storage so it survives a reload
Build a dynamic form where users add and remove rows, validate each row, and persist the data to local storage with tests for bad input

schedule.title: APIs and the final project
schedule.exercise: Project plan: sketch the pages, the interactive feature and the deployment steps for a responsive site published to a static host.

tasks.title: Fetch a JSON file of products with fetch and promises and render the items as a list on the page, with a message if the request fails
Fetch weather data from a public API, show it in cards, handle loading and error states and cache the last result for offline use
Build a responsive multi-page site with an interactive feature, check accessibility and speed, and publish it to a static host
